youtube.aciklama: A cochlear implant needs a cochlea in which to place the electrodes and an auditory nerve to carry the signal. The auditory brainstem implant (ABI) bypasses both of these steps, and the electrodes are placed directly on the cochlear nucleus in the brainstem; the first ABI was placed in 1979, a single electrode, in a patient with neurofibromatosis type 2.
